data.gender_notes: Rukhsana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rukhsana is an Islamic name for girls. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Rukhsah' which means 'face brightened'. The name Rukhsana carries the meaning “Face Brightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rukhsana usually hope their child will grow to embody face brightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rukhsana is often associated with divine blessings and protection. It is believed that a child named Rukhsana will be safeguarded by Allah's grace.
data.etymology: Rukhsana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Face Brightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rukhsana total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
